plan.notes: Official Utah Tech University 2025-2026 Catalog, Applied Sociology BA/BS graduation plan text PDF (program awarded as BA/BS; the published plan includes the BA foreign-language sequence). Semester totals as printed: 14 / 15 / 14 / 16 / 16 / 16 / 13 / 15 = 119, matching the printed 'Total Hours 119' — the source's own total is 119, not 120. Course titles verified against the official 2025-2026 Sociology Minor and Integrated Studies - Sociology Emphasis texts: SOC 1010 Introduction to Sociology (SS, GC); SOC 3111 Research Methods; SOC 3112 Social Statistics; SOC 3140 Sociological Theory; CJ 3300 Research Methods in Criminology and Criminal Justice; SOC 4890 Applied Sociology Internship; SOC 4910 Senior Capstone; MATH 1040 Introduction to Statistics (MA); ENGL 1010 Introduction to Writing (EN); ENGL 2010 Interm Writing Selected Topics: (EN). 'Sociology Elective: Lower Division' (2 slots) and 'Sociology Elective: Upper Division' (7 slots) are numbered choice placeholders for sociology courses — see the program text for the eligible list. 'Foreign Language: 1010/1020/2010/2020' are choice placeholders (language varies; part of the BA foreign-language requirement). Prerequisites not populated from the plan; see official course descriptions in the 2025-2026 catalog.
